decisions.reason: Full management control per location does not change the requirement to provide Wix Bookings on location sites.
Per-location operational control does not alter the master site's location listing, navigation, or routing behavior; the same-message navigation change is already represented.
Per-location management control does not necessarily modify the template-based structure used to integrate new franchise locations.
Granting each location full operational control does not change the shared Smash Room brand identity or its application.
Location management control is operational and does not change the competitor reference or the simple, easy-to-navigate visual design direction.
